Maria (CSM): Quick weekly check-in for Marsden — sharing p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming for last 7d.
Alex (CS): Thanks. Paste of numbers below.
Alex (CS): /chat — model: redchat-3b
Alex (CS): streaming p95: 210ms, p99: 630ms
Alex (CS): non-stream p95: 480ms, p99: 1.9s
Alex (CS): /summarize — model: opt-1.3b
Alex (CS): streaming p95: 340ms, p99: 1.2s
Alex (CS): non-stream p95: 1.1s, p99: 3.8s
Kevin (SRE): Noted spike on /summarize p99 — any correlating error-rate blips?
Maria (CSM): Yes — error rate for /summarize jumped to 2.1% on Tue (from baseline 0.3%). Mostly 413/502 from payload trimming + model OOM fallbacks.
Kevin (SRE): I pulled kube logs — a few larger-than-expected requests hit our max_input_size threshold. Autoscaler bounced a node for ~4m — caused a cascade of retries.
Sam (Product): Usage trend: Marsden has +28% token volume this week vs last. Their test ingest job doubled after enabling long-context mode.
Maria (CSM): Spend alert: monthly estimate +18% QoQ if trend continues. Customer notified; they're ok but flagged for optimization.
Alex (CS): Quick config suggestion: enable prefix KV cache for /summarize and cap streaming window -> reduces non-stream fallback by ~60% in our staging tests.
Kevin (SRE): I'll put a mitigation: increase max_input_size to 6MB for Marsden's tenant in dedicated config and add rate-limit backpressure for large payloads.
Maria (CSM): Suggested enablement: 30-min ops walkthrough with Marsden engineers to show KV caching + payload best-practices. @Sam can you lead?
Sam (Product): Yup — can do Tues 10AM PT. I'll prepare a one-pager and demo script.
Maria (CSM): Renewal sentiment: still positive, but they mentioned "latency spikes during peak import" as main concern. If p99s stay high we risk discount ask.
Kevin (SRE): Short-term: implement max_input_size bump + cache. Medium-term: schedule re-quantization profile for opt-1.3b to reduce memory pressure.
Maria (CSM): Action items:
- Kevin: apply tenant config change + monitor (ETA: today EOD)
- Sam: enablement session prep + run Tues 10AM PT
- Alex: follow-up with a micro-benchmark showing streaming vs non-stream for their sample payloads (ETA: Mon)
- Maria: update renewal risk score and notify AE (ETA: Mon)
Alex (CS): I'll attach perf graphs in the follow-up thread and include per-route cost delta.
Maria (CSM): Any objections? Otherwise I'll close this weekly thread and create a postmortem if spikes persist.
DeployBot: Alert created — incident ticket #INC-2026-983 linked to config change.
Liz (Ops): I'll keep an eye on billing alerts for sudden spend jumps.
Maria (CSM): Thanks team :thumbsup: — will update Marsden after Kevin confirms the config change.
